resources.string: Tap to exclude this app from battery optimization so the server stays alive when the screen is off or the app is closed.

1. Turn the server ON (it keeps running even if you close the app).
2. Connect the iPad to the same Wi‑Fi as this phone.
3. Open the http:// address (or scan the QR) on the iPad — that is your billing kiosk.
4. Tap Open Admin Panel here to manage menu, prices, images, order of items, billing settings and orders.
5. Pair your thermal printer in Android Bluetooth settings, pick it under Choose Bluetooth Printer. Paid orders print automatically.

Default admin PIN: 1234
